name: AM-1220
summary: AM-1220 is a drug that acts as a potent and moderately selective agonist for the cannabinoid receptor CB1, with around 19 times selectivity for CB1 over the related CB2 receptor. It was originally invented in the early 1990s by a team led by Thomas D'Ambra at Sterling Winthrop, but has subsequently been researched by many others, most notably the team led by Alexandros Makriyannis at the University of Connecticut.

pharmacology.text: AM-1220 is a drug that acts as a potent and moderately selective agonist for the cannabinoid receptor CB1, with around 19 times selectivity for CB1 over the related CB2 receptor.

summaryZh: AM-1220，化學名：1-[(N-甲基-2-哌啶基)甲基]-3-(1-萘甲醯基)吲哚，分子式C26H26N2O，是一種鎮痛藥，屬於亞歷山德羅斯·馬克里揚尼斯小組合成的萘甲醯基吲哚類AM系列大麻素，2015年列入《非藥用類麻醉藥品和精神藥品名錄》。

uses.en: It is a research compound used to study the CB1 cannabinoid receptor. It has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它是用來研究 CB1 大麻素受體的研究用化合物，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它是用来研究 CB1 大麻素受体的研究用化合物，没有医疗用途。

sideEffects.en: It has not been studied in people. Potent synthetic cannabinoids as a class can cause a racing heart, anxiety, confusion, vomiting and, at times, psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 它未曾在人體研究過。強效合成大麻素作為一類，可能造成心跳急促、焦慮、混亂、嘔吐，有時還會引發精神病。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它未曾在人体研究过。强效合成大麻素作为一类，可能造成心跳急促、焦虑、混乱、呕吐，有时还会引发精神病。

fact.en: It was first made in the early 1990s by a team led by Thomas D'Ambra at Sterling Winthrop, the same laboratory that produced JWH-style aminoalkylindoles' forerunner WIN 55,212-2.
fact.zh: 它最早由 Thomas D'Ambra 帶領的團隊於 1990 年代初在 Sterling Winthrop 合成，同一個實驗室也做出了胺烷基吲哚類的先驅 WIN 55,212-2。
fact.zhHans: 它最早由 Thomas D'Ambra 带领的团队于 1990 年代初在 Sterling Winthrop 合成，同一个实验室也做出了胺烷基吲哚类的先驱 WIN 55,212-2。
